descriptions.text: Enchanted Gnome FarSeerer. Used to sight long-range targets for their bomb runs, the FarSeerer is credited as one of the key inventions that allowed the Dirigible Gnomes to obtain air superiority. When properly installed on a Gnomish Dreadnaught, this device increases the accuracy of gravity-based bombs by 75%. Allows for inspection and information on objects at a distance. It's pretty good for spying on your neighbors, too. You don't need porn when you got this thing hanging off the edge of your airship. Warning: All gnomes targeted with this device are given a notice that they are being watched.

recap.text: Skarn lets Carl look through the white tube of pipes and gears that Flint found in the dunes. Carl sees it is a dirigible gnome bomb sight that tells every gnome it targets they are being watched. Donut steals it in ten seconds flat and forgets the thirty gold pieces Carl told her to leave. Carl aims it at gnomes from the ATV, and the flying fortress keeps moving south.

beats.headline: Skarn watches the patrol
beats.text: Skarn moves to the telescope, which points toward the desert. He likes to watch the patrol to make sure they are okay; Flint says if he grows up big and strong, maybe they will let him stay and he can join it one day. The telescope is a white tube covered in pipes and gears, made of something odd, maybe ceramic. Carl examines it: a dirigible gnome bomb sight that lets its user inspect things at a distance, and tells every gnome it targets that they are being watched. Flint found it in the dunes, Skarn says, among lots of crashed stuff from the last war. There! There it is!
beats.gist: Carl examines the telescope Skarn watches the patrol through: a gnome bomb sight that alerts every target.

beats.headline: Ten seconds flat
beats.text: Part of Carl feels bad about stealing from little Skarn and his burgeoning charge-people-to-look-through-his-telescope business, but there is no time to debate it. He knocks, checks that Flint is out, and tells the boy to run to the Toe if the bombs start, and to tell all his friends. While they talk, Donut scales the wall, leaps to the roof and steals the gnomish farseer telescope in ten seconds flat. Carl told her to leave thirty gold pieces on the roof as payment. She tells him she forgot.
beats.gist: Donut steals Skarn's telescope in ten seconds and forgets Carl's thirty gold pieces of payment.

beats.headline: Letting the gnomes know
beats.text: Wynne the dirigible gnome is duct-taped to the raised back seat of the ATV as Carl heads out across the desert, the farseer in his hand, staring up at the flying fortress. The damn thing is huge. He focuses on several different gnomes long enough that each receives a notification that they are being watched. That is the point: they want the gnomes to know they are here. The Wasteland does not bomb them. It keeps moving south, toward Hump Town.
beats.gist: Carl watches gnomes through the farseer so each gets notified, while the fortress keeps moving south.
